title: Unit Event — Find the Dream View — Episode7 Leo/need's Stage

meta.Event Outline: With their successes performing for a commercial and at Jam Fest, Shiho and the rest of Leo/need are feeling their growth as pro musicians. Then, they get an offer to open for a super popular group's concert.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And all the seats up to the third deck are filled. This is pretty overwhelming...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I don't just mean the physical distance between us...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, some people are walking on stage.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Oh, the opening act, right?
Some no-names.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The emotional distance too. It's like there's a wall set up between the stage and the stands...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're going to tear down that wall and suck them into our world!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
...!
Wait, the drummer's kicking things off?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (First, I have to get everybody's interest.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're Leo/need! Thank you all for having us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Alright, we're off to a great start.
And the timing on the lights worked like a charm.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We can still do better. A lot better!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We gotta create a huge wave of fun and excitement with our music!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wow, everyone's producing much more energy than normal...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That means I have to take our sound, wrap it all together, and send it to everyone in this arena...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (After this chorus, Ichika and Shiho have their solos.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They both practiced so hard to blow this audience away.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa, listen to that palm-muting!
So crunchy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(More energy...
We need to get the whole crowd involved!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to put our hearts and souls into our sound, into our performance!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi and Shiho are totally off the hook...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We gotta ride this wave together!
The four of us can make these next notes explode!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(...!
More and more people are clapping along now...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We gotta keep sprinting all the way to the finish line!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That was a seamless transition. And Ichika's singing sounds spectacular.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, she's maintained the momentum they built with their first song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We need to keep drawing in the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And make our performance reverberate deeper and stronger!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Me too...!
Their music really clicks with me for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The beginning involves understanding the pain of others and empathizing with them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That feeling of not having your voice heard. That sense of feeling stuck. Like no one is listening. Like you don't matter...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The dreadful thought of things going on like this forever.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But we're not just here to show empathy.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We need to keep the energy going. Like a warm hand reaching out, we'll show them that everything will be alright.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then, we're gonna take them to a place that's filled with light and hope!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's like the lights, their instruments and singing have all become one, carrying their feelings all together.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's time to make our sound and thoughts ring out! With everything we have!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Fill this entire space with our music. Put our all into this sound!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Forget about everything else, you guys...
Let's enjoy this dreamlike moment together!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We're gonna use everything we have into this sound so that you're all able to stand up and move forward tomorrow...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our sound and their cheering are melding together. It's making my entire body shake, like a physical wave of heat coming at us.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to take this energy and throw it right back at them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I know we still have a lot more to give!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can tell that our music is reaching the entire crowd. And they're responding with everything they have.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're all moving as one. It's like the arena itself is alive.)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: From the front row to the top of the third deck, over ten thousand people will be going wild as you play for them.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: And you get to see that from the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This energy. The way it's making my heart dance. This is so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna connect with them more. I want to really move their hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to show them what Leo/need's music is all about!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Their feelings are all so clear to me.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This is the strongest they've ever been.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(My heart is completely theirs.
They've pulled me into their world and shaken me to my core...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is what Leo/need can do on stage...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: People hardly ever cheer for an opening act like this...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Bravo, Mr. Shindo. These girls are a real gem.
